name: Rowan Thorne
title: The Wayfinder
speciality: Accurate ranged attacks, rapid volleys and arranging bows beside quivers to make every shot count.

specialPowers.name: Volley
specialPowers.description: Every third turn, all equipped ranged items activate twice. Quiver adjacency strengthens applicable ranged activations.
specialPowers.visualDirection: Quick, measured bow shots with a clear draw-and-release motion. Use ordinary arrows by default; magical trails are not an inherent class power.

weapons.name: Ashwood recurve bow
weapons.relationship: Corresponds to the Ashwood Bow inventory item; the existing accepted design uses a tall recurved silhouette.
weapons.description: Warm brown wooden limbs, a darker wrapped riser and one continuous taut string. At rest, the viewer-right hand wraps the riser with the thumb and fingers visibly overlapping it; do not draw the string across his face.

weapons.name: Hunting quiver
weapons.relationship: Starting inventory item and signature visual equipment.
weapons.description: Worn brown leather shoulder quiver with a restrained group of cream-feathered arrows. It sits behind the viewer-left shoulder and remains separate from the head in a portrait.

weapons.name: Trail knife
weapons.relationship: Optional sheathed costume tool; adds no inventory ability.
weapons.description: A small plain utility knife on the belt, normally sheathed and visually secondary to the bow.

itemAliasNotes: shortbow is displayed as Ashwood Bow; quiver is displayed as Hunting Quiver.

bio.summary: A wilderness courier who knows forgotten roads better than the people who drew the maps.
bio.origin: Rowan carried medicine and letters between isolated hill villages long before he became an archer for hire. After a familiar route vanished beneath a spreading sinkhole, he began tracing the old passages below it. He enters the dungeon to discover where those roads went, and to recover the people and supplies lost with them.
personality: Distrustful of grand promises but loyal to practical kindness
bio.motivation: Reopen a safe route between the scattered villages and bring back evidence of what is swallowing the old roads.
bio.mannerisms: Pauses to listen before opening a door, knots spare cord around an arrow shaft and remembers people by the routes they travel.
bio.voice: Easy, economical speech with a quiet joke at an unexpectedly tense moment.
bio.quote: There is a way through. There usually is.

physicalAppearance.build: Lean and athletic, with flexible shoulders, a compact torso and strong but unexaggerated legs. His posture suggests stamina and easy movement rather than heavy lifting.
physicalAppearance.silhouette: Forest-green hood framing a visible angled face, ochre scarf, fitted leather shoulder armor, a long split cloak and tall wooden bow on the viewer's right.
physicalAppearance.headTreatment: Visible anime-inspired adult face within an open hood.
physicalAppearance.headShape: Slightly angular oval face with a defined cheekbone, narrow jaw and proportionate chin.
physicalAppearance.face: Warm light-to-medium skin, a straight simplified nose, small relaxed mouth and softly arched brows. Keep the three-quarter perspective coherent and give the far eye less visible width.
physicalAppearance.eyes: Muted green eyes with deliberate dark upper lids and a focused, alert gaze toward the viewer's right.
physicalAppearance.hair: Dark chestnut-brown hair swept diagonally across the forehead, with short pointed locks emerging from the hood. Keep hair as structured masses rather than many thin strands.
physicalAppearance.headwear: An open forest-green hood with a soft pointed crown and broad shaded folds; it frames the face without casting it into unreadable darkness.
physicalAppearance.upperBody: Green layered tunic beneath fitted brown leather shoulder and forearm armor; a warm ochre scarf around the neck; diagonal leather quiver strap and a small antique-brass clasp.
physicalAppearance.lowerBody: Charcoal trousers, overlapping green tunic tails, brown belt and a small practical pouch. Wrapped leather knee and shin protection above sturdy walking boots.
physicalAppearance.hands: Fingerless or open-finger leather bracers with visible warm skin. The bow hand encloses the riser; the resting hand hangs naturally with relaxed fingers.
physicalAppearance.cloak: Long muted-green cloak hanging behind the viewer-left side, split enough to reveal both legs and grounded feet.
distinguishingFeatures: Chestnut forelock inside an open green hood
Ochre scarf against muted green clothing
Tall recurved bow with a readable wrapped grip
physicalAppearance.expressionAndBearing: Calm, watchful and approachable, with a slight suggestion of a smile rather than a broad grin.
physicalAppearance.effects: None in the default idle design.
physicalAppearance.portraitDirection: Optically center the hood-framed face, keep hair, hood crown and chin complete, and retain a little ochre scarf. Remove arrow fletching, quiver edges, bow/string and unrelated cloak fragments; reconstruct obscured hood or hair.
avoid: Quiver arrows filling the portrait margins

body.measurement: Head/headwear to soles; exclude held equipment, detached effects and transparent padding.

portrait.source: Original generated concept or another sufficiently detailed identity source, independently framed and cleaned.
portrait.framing: Optically center the visible head; preserve complete hair/headwear and chin, with modest neck and shoulder context.
portrait.obstructions: Remove incidental weapons, quivers, spell fragments and other obstructions; reconstruct hidden head details. Retain intentional helmets and masks.

generation.pose: Upright, relaxed and alert, slight three-quarter turn toward the viewer's right, grounded feet and a natural weight shift.
generation.rendering: Original fantasy pixel art with cohesive adult proportions, deliberate connected clusters, sculpted material planes, selective highlights and restrained texture. Exposed faces use intentional anime-inspired eye/lid, nose and mouth shapes.
deliverables: Separate 64 x 64 portrait spritex authoring JSON
generation.review: Inspect body, grip and portrait at native/intended display size. Technical validation is separate from user approval.
